What we restore

Pick the situation that matches yours. Each page explains what we can do, what we can’t, and how insurance usually treats it.

  • Vandalism and break-in restoration: keyed paint, spray paint, broken-glass cleanup, damaged or soiled interiors.
  • Paint overspray removal: construction, roofing and industrial overspray lifted off paint, glass and trim without repainting.
  • Water damage restoration: rain and leak intrusion, wet carpet and padding, odor and mildew prevention.
  • Broken glass and interior cleanup: replacement glass is coordinated through our third-party glass partner; we clean the broken glass out of the interior and restore the damage the break caused.

How it works

  1. Send photos and a short description through our estimate form, or call the shop.
  2. We review the damage and reply with next steps during business hours. Some jobs we can estimate from photos; others need a look in person.
  3. You receive a written, itemized estimate with photos — the documentation you share with your insurer if you are filing a claim.
  4. Once you (and your insurer, if you are claiming) decide to proceed, we coordinate and schedule the work and keep you posted until pickup.

What we are honest about

  • Deep scratches that are through the clear coat and paint need a body shop. We will tell you that instead of polishing something that cannot be polished.
  • We do not install glass ourselves. We coordinate glass replacement through our third-party glass partner and handle the related cleanup and restoration.
  • Severe flooding (water above the seat bottoms, submerged electronics, standing water for days) needs a qualified inspection and your insurer’s review before anyone talks restoration. Our work is interior cleanup and restoration, and we will tell you when damage is beyond that.
  • Hail and dent repair: ask us. We will point you to the right option for the damage rather than promise a result.

Working with your insurance

Vandalism, falling objects, water and glass damage are typically handled under the comprehensive portion of an auto policy, but every policy is different. Ask your insurer how a claim could affect your premium; with the itemized estimate in hand, whether to claim or pay out of pocket is your choice. Coverage, and what your deductible is, are always your insurance company’s decision, never ours.

Contact your insurer to open or discuss a claim; we provide an itemized, written estimate and damage documentation, and we coordinate the repair process once you decide to proceed.

Questions people ask

Do I have to file an insurance claim to use you?

No. Many customers pay out of pocket, especially when the repair is close to their deductible. You get the same written estimate either way, so you can decide after you see the number.

How does the estimate work with my insurance claim?

You receive a written, itemized estimate with dated photos of the damage. Contact your insurer to open or discuss the claim and share that documentation with them; coverage, deductible and approval decisions are your insurance company’s.

How fast can you look at my vehicle?

Send photos through the estimate form and we will reply with next steps during business hours. If the damage needs an in-person look, we will tell you when to bring it by.

Do you repair body damage or replace glass?

We are a detail and restoration shop. We handle paint correction, interior restoration, odor and cleanup. Dents and panel repair go to a body shop. Glass replacement is third-party work we coordinate through our glass partner.
